description: Statically inspect a native ELF, PE, or Mach-O file (ADR-0003): format, architecture, entry point, section layout, linked libraries, and imported/exported symbols, plus optional printable strings. Pure byte parsing under hard caps (128 MiB file, bounded tables); the file is never loaded or executed, and every name and string is AIDefence-screened before return. Use when you need an inventory of what a native binary links against and exposes before deciding where to look next — not for disassembly or decompilation, which this does not do. Malformed headers yield warnings, not errors.

includeStrings.description: Also return up to 200 printable strings (default false)

path.description: Absolute path to a native binary (ELF, PE, or Mach-O)

name: rure_analyze_binary
